title: Remove every line-count ceiling from core by CEO decision; keep sizes measured
goal: CEO decision 2026-11-16, on the report that every other ceiling (runtime code, tooling, vendored code, per-file limits) was unchanged after the test budget was lifted: "remove all ceiling". Remove every line-count ceiling from tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs (per pillar, per category and per file), keep the sizes measured and printed so growth stays visible, leave the dependency-reach ceilings that Mandates 60 and 69 rest on, and make the documents say so.

reuse.searched: tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs (every ceiling and how each is measured), the ceiling rules and wave log in docs/lean-core.md, AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/architecture.md, every other mention of the lean ceilings in the mandates and .agents/identity.json (Mandates 5, 60, 69, 78 and 79 rest on the dependency ceilings, none on a line count), and xtask fast-release, which runs this test target. The existing measurement code is kept and only stops failing on size; nothing new is built.

limitations: Removed: every line-count ceiling in core (eight per-pillar src ceilings, the runtime, vendor-facade, test, tooling and vendored-source budgets, and five per-file ceilings). Nothing in core fails on source size any more.

Kept, because they are not line counts and the CEO's words were read as the line budgets named in the report they answered: the dependency-reach ceilings (third-party crates 96, workspace crates 33, workspace members 49, Cargo.lock packages 181, direct facade edges 9), which Mandates 60 and 69 rest on, and the unsafe-baseline file count (2). The script-count, orphan-source and vendor-product file ratchets in other tests, and the time budgets (<10s warm pipeline, cold compile, startup), are also unchanged. Whether those go too is the CEO's to say.
Sizes are still measured and printed by the same test on every run; that is a report, not a gate, and nobody is told when a number grows.

The Susi Board could be read but not written from this cloud session (HTTP 403 on refs/board/* and refs/claims/*), so the Heads-up this change deserves could not be posted; no Claim or Landed item either, and the record is closed by hand (Mandate 76 section 7).
Main is unqualified development, not a release.
